prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add a `config` command with `set`, `get`, and `list` actions. Support the keys `dataFile` and `defaultJson`; accept `--config-file` on every command so tests can isolate configuration. Explicit command-line options override configured defaults. Writes must be atomic, unknown keys and invalid boolean values must fail without changing configuration, and paths are resolved relative to the config file. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/config.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON `config list` displays the banner before settings, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `CONFIG`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Read-JsonFile {
    param([string]$Path)
    $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)) { return @() }
    return @($raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    # --- config command coverage ---
    $configRoot = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'cfg'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $configRoot -Force | Out-Null
    $configFile = Join-Path $configRoot 'taskforge.config.json'

    $setData = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', 'dataFile', 'store.json', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($setData.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set dataFile should succeed'
    $getData = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', 'dataFile', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($getData.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $getData.Output -eq 'store.json') 'config get should return the stored value'

    $unknownKey = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', 'bogus', 'x', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($unknownKey.ExitCode -ne 0) 'config set with unknown key should fail'
    $badBool = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', 'defaultJson', 'nope', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($badBool.ExitCode -ne 0) 'config set with invalid boolean should fail'
    $afterFailure = @(Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json')).Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($afterFailure.dataFile -eq 'store.json' -and $null -eq $afterFailure.defaultJson) 'failed writes should not change configuration'

    $setJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', 'defaultJson', 'true', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($setJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set defaultJson should succeed'

    $bannerFile = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $scriptPath) '../assets/config.txt'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bannerFile) 'config banner asset should exist'
    $bannerFirstLine = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerFile)[0]
    $listText = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($listText.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config list should succeed'
    $listLines = $listText.Output -split "`n"
    Assert-True ($listLines[0] -eq $bannerFirstLine) 'config list should show the banner before settings'
    Assert-True ($listText.Output.Contains('CONFIG') -and $listText.Output.Contains('dataFile = store.json')) 'config list should include banner text and settings'

    $listJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (-not $listJson.Output.Contains('CONFIG')) 'config list --json should be banner-free'
    $listParsed = $listJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($listParsed.dataFile -eq 'store.json' -and $listParsed.defaultJson -eq $true) 'config list --json should return settings'

    # defaultJson from config should drive output format; dataFile resolves relative to config file
    $configAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Config task', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($configAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add with config should succeed'
    $configAdded = $configAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($configAdded.id -eq 1) 'config defaultJson should force JSON output without --json'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $configRoot 'store.json')) 'config dataFile should resolve relative to the config file'

    # explicit command-line options override configured defaults
    $overrideData = Join-Path $configRoot 'override.json'
    $override = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Override task', '--config-file', $configFile, '--data-file', $overrideData)
    Assert-True ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $overrideData) -and (@(Read-JsonFile $overrideData).Count -eq 1)) '--data-file should override configured dataFile'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 22 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
